messages.content: Good afternoon, this is Priya Kumar from Bank Islam digital channels team in KL. Saya nak initiate identity verification untuk salah seorang customer kami yang sedang dalam in-app chat — conversation_id `conv-bi-20260521-441`. Customer ni nak approve a high-value FX transfer dalam RM 25,000 punya range, so kami perlu high assurance level. User CRM reference 'CIF-BI-998812', registered phone +60182217734. Boleh tolong set up?

Good afternoon, Madam Priya. Thank you for reaching out to the CPaaS trust desk. I will initialise the verification context for conversation `conv-bi-20260521-441` at a high assurance level, factoring in the RM 25,000 transaction value. Please hold on for a moment.

Noted, Madam. I will create the session now with the SMS OTP and biometric plan, the webhook callback to your endpoint for all session events, and the CRM metadata embedded. Please hold on for a moment.
